title: Delayed home internet installation
situation: You recently moved to a new city for work and arranged for an internet company to install a connection in your home. The installation has now been delayed twice.
bullets: explain why you need a reliable internet connection at home
describe what happened on the two days the installation was booked
say what you would like the company to do now

title: Asking your manager to support a training course
situation: You would like to attend a training course that would help you in your job, and you would like your company to pay for it.
bullets: describe the course you would like to attend
explain how it would help you and your team
suggest how your work could be covered while you are on the course

title: Inviting a friend to your farewell gathering
situation: You will soon move overseas to start a new job, and you are planning a small gathering for your friends before you leave.
bullets: give details of the gathering
explain why you would particularly like this friend to be there
ask your friend to help you with something for the gathering

title: Broken lights on a path to the station
situation: Many people walk along a path near your home to get to the train station. For the past month, the lights along the path have not been working.
bullets: describe the path and the problem
explain why this is a concern for local residents
suggest what the council could do to make the path safer

title: Accidental damage in a rented apartment
situation: You are renting an apartment. Last weekend you accidentally damaged something in it.
bullets: describe what was damaged and how it happened
apologise for the damage
suggest how it could be repaired

title: Thanking a friend for a place to stay
situation: Last month you stayed with a friend for a week while you attended job interviews in their city. You have just heard the results of the interviews.
bullets: tell your friend the results of your interviews
explain how their help made a difference to you
apologise for something you forgot to do during your stay

title: Joining a professional association for IT workers
situation: You are going to move to Australia to work in the IT industry, and you would like to join a professional association for IT workers there.
recipient: the membership secretary of the association
bullets: give details of your qualifications and work experience
explain why you want to join the association
ask for information about membership

title: Replying to a new colleague before you start
situation: You have accepted a job with a software company in another country and will start next month. A senior member of your new team has written to you to welcome you.
bullets: describe your experience in your current job
explain what you are looking forward to in the new job
ask some questions about your first week

title: Advice for a friend moving to your city
situation: A friend from your home country has been offered a job in the city where you now live and has asked for your advice about moving there.
bullets: describe what everyday life is like in the city
suggest how your friend could find somewhere to live
say how you could help when your friend arrives
